company.shortDescription: Stonly provides interactive knowledge base and guidance software for customer support, self-service, and employee training.
company.description: Stonly provides interactive knowledge management software that helps organizations create guided workflows, documentation, and self-service resources for customers and employees. Its platform supports customer support, onboarding, and training by delivering step-by-step guidance and searchable knowledge across multiple channels.

productsAndServices.name: Stonly Interactive Guides

productsAndServices.description: AI capabilities that summarize support tickets, identify resolution paths, generate responses, and provide answers from an organization’s structured knowledge.
productsAndServices.name: Stonly AI Agent Assist and AI Answers

productsAndServices.description: A customer- and agent-facing knowledge base for publishing organized help content, interactive guides, troubleshooting instructions, and process documentation.
productsAndServices.name: Stonly Knowledge Base

productsAndServices.description: An embeddable widget for delivering contextual knowledge, interactive guides, onboarding experiences, and support resources within digital products or workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Stonly Widget and In-Product Guidance

productsAndServices.description: Integration and API capabilities that connect Stonly knowledge and guidance with support, CRM, service-management, and AI systems.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $22,000,000, or 86.27% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,829,230 to $105,545,210, a 27.56x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 82 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 67 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Fin, Zendesk, eGain Corporation.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
